items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I knew his brother Carl, who later became his manager. He hung out with my brother Stuart.

ctx.x: It just came about. I knew the Tatum family all my life. They lived five houses from us. Sister Tatum and Sister Hendricks were sisters in the church. We just knew each other. I knew his brother Carl, who later became his manager. He hung out with my brother Stuart. They always went around and did little – what kids do. Stole stuff from the 5 and 10, went down to the theater and sneaked in. They did all those things. I knew Art all my life, because we were – we did a lot of amateur shows, and we would be on the…
What were some of the songs that you two did together?
